subject.title: fix: prevent silent message loss from EmbeddedAttemptSessionTakeoverError

question: Should unconfigured embedded provider connection and request-timeout retries permanently move from SDK-internal attempts during prompt-lock release to one orchestrator-level full fallback-cycle retry?
rationale: The relocation keeps default retries outside the released session-lock window, but it changes retry timing, fallback traversal, and terminal behavior; source history and upstream SDK contracts cannot determine the intended permanent product policy.

options.title: Approve orchestrator ownership
options.body: Keep SDK retries disabled for unconfigured embedded calls and restore one bounded full-cycle retry after the lock is reacquired.

options.title: Narrow the session repair
options.body: Land owned transcript fencing and takeover surfacing without changing default retry ownership.

recommendation.title: Approve orchestrator ownership
recommendation.body: Keep SDK retries disabled for unconfigured embedded calls and restore one bounded full-cycle retry after the lock is reacquired.
